stopping_rule.note: Saturation requires at least three completed rounds and the final two qualifying rounds each having at least 20 raw candidates with marginal new-identity yield <= 0.05. An intervening sub-threshold round breaks the qualifying tail.

boundary: Open-world query/round contracts fix declared retrieval seeds, round accounting, independence, and the literal marginal-yield stop rule under the frozen A2 analysis universe and A2 bounded-frame checkpoint. They do not establish global completeness, unseen-population size, market share, effectiveness, commercialization, S2 publication authority, or v4.2 assessment effect. F11 remains diagnostic-only for the primary unseen-population estimator.
